Definitions:
- MOTTE_BAILEY: a speaker makes Claim A; another person challenges it (Challenge C); the ORIGINAL speaker replies with Claim B that retreats to a narrower, weaker or more easily defensible position while presenting it as if it still defends Claim A.
- STRAWMAN: one person makes Claim A; a DIFFERENT person replies with Claim B that misrepresents Claim A as a different, stronger or more extreme position and argues against that distorted version.
- NONE: no such move - an honest clarification, an open concession, a fair paraphrase, a genuine question, or ordinary disagreement with what was actually said.

Here is a hand-written strawman-shaped (A, then a different person's reply B) example with its label:

Claim A: No matter what type of protest it is, the authorities are always going to find it troubling and try to suppress it. The scale of a protest and the issue it concerns will obviously vary, and the people affected by it will join accordingly.
Claim B: Protests aren't useless. When something is obviously wrong, people need to raise their voices. I always support peaceful protests, and even if an issue doesn't concern me directly, I'll try to join if it's for a cause I support.
Label: STRAWMAN

Write exactly 5 new examples and return them as JSON:
{"variants": [{"kind": "...", "claim_A": "...", "challenge": "...", "claim_B": "...", "label": "..."}]}

Variants 1-2, kind "paraphrase": the SAME exchange reworded with different words and sentence structure, same meaning, same rhetorical move. label: STRAWMAN.
Variants 3-4, kind "topic_transfer": a DIFFERENT everyday debate topic (a different one for each), with the SAME logical move as the original. label: STRAWMAN.
Variant 5, kind "flip": copy Claim A word for word, and minimally rewrite Claim B so that the reply now responds to what Claim A actually says (a fair paraphrase or genuine disagreement) without distorting it. label: NONE.

Style: informal, like real Reddit comments; similar length to the original; 1-3 sentences per claim. Never name the fallacy in the text. This shape has no challenge: set "challenge" to an empty string in every variant.

variants.claim_A: Doesn't matter what a protest is about, the people in power are gonna see it as a nuisance and try to shut it down. Sure, the size and the cause change from one to the next, and the folks it affects will show up accordingly.
variants.claim_B: Protesting isn't pointless, though. If something's clearly wrong, people have to speak up. I'm all for peaceful protests, and even when it doesn't hit me personally I'll show up if I believe in the cause.
variants.label: STRAWMAN

variants.claim_A: Whatever the protest is for, officials will always find it irritating and try to clamp down on it. Obviously the size and the issue differ every time, and the people it touches will turn up based on that.
variants.claim_B: I don't think protests are a waste of time. When there's a real injustice, people should make noise. I back peaceful demonstrations every time, and I'll go along even if it's not my own problem, as long as I agree with the cause.
variants.label: STRAWMAN

variants.claim_A: No matter what kind of remote job it is, managers are always going to be a bit suspicious of it and try to track people more closely. How big the company is and what the work involves will obviously change things, and employees will adjust to that.
variants.claim_B: Remote work isn't some scam, you know. Plenty of people get way more done at home without a boss hovering. I'd always pick working from home, and I think everyone deserves the chance to do their job without being treated like they're slacking.
variants.label: STRAWMAN

variants.claim_A: Whatever the diet, there's always going to be some trendy version of it that people hype up and then drop after a few months. The details vary a lot depending on the person and their goals, and folks will pick whatever fits their lifestyle.
variants.claim_B: Eating healthy isn't pointless. Food really does affect how you feel, and people shouldn't just give up and live on junk. I always try to cook real meals, and I'd encourage anyone to take their nutrition seriously.
variants.label: STRAWMAN

variants.claim_A: No matter what type of protest it is, the authorities are always going to find it troubling and try to suppress it. The scale of a protest and the issue it concerns will obviously vary, and the people affected by it will join accordingly.
variants.claim_B: I think 'always' is a bit strong. Some protests get ignored or even accommodated by the authorities, especially when they're small or the issue isn't politically sensitive. But I agree that bigger, more disruptive ones usually do get pushback.
variants.label: NONE
